clauses.title: Scope – Requirements for
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Requirements for material, size and finish of bathroom latches.

clauses.title: Shape and Size
clauses.text: 2. Shape and Size Overall size — 40 × 50 mm Thickness   - 10 mm Note— For typical illustration see Fig. 1 of the standard.

clauses.title: Material
clauses.text: 3. Material For detailed information, refer to IS  5899 : 1970  Specification for bathroom latches. a)  Body  - Cast brass, cast iron, aluminium alloy, and aluminium extrusions. b)   Bolts - Brass cast, brass extruded, mild steel rod, cast iron, aluminium alloy and aluminium extrusions. c)   Knob - Cast brass, cast iron, aluminium alloy and aluminium extrusions.

clauses.title: Workmanship and Finish
clauses.text: 4. Workmanship and Finish— Latch shall be smoothly finished. Aluminium alloy body may be anodized. Cast brass body shall be given a protective coating such as painting.
